text:
erin (cs): Customer (Acme) opened a support ticket — bulk embed job suddenly failing to index into their vector DB. DB returns: 'dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 512'. Happening for ~20% of batch. They upgraded our SDK to 0.9.2 around the same time.

alex h: Any sample request or logs we can repro with?

erin (cs): Pasting minimal repro curl they used: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input": "[\"doc1\", \"doc2\"]", "model": "text-embed-1536"}'
```

priya: Whoa — they double-stringified the array. input is a single string that contains a JSON array. Server treats that as one scalar input and returns one embedding. That could be why DB sees 512 (they were using an older fallback embed model for scalars in this flow).

morgan: Confirmed on local repro. The request above returns a single vector shape (1, 512). If I send the same payload with input as an actual JSON array (no extra quotes) I get (2, 1536).

devkit-bot: Repro run logged -> reproduced. Response payload excerpt: 
```
{"data": [{"embedding": [0.0012, ...], "index": 0}], "model": "text-embed-512"}
```

erin (cs): Customer is trying to bulk ingest into Pinecone/Weaviate expecting 1536 and fails on insert (DB returns HTTP 400 dimension mismatch). They hit a pipeline/ops outage because of this.

alex h: Root causes: a) client double-stringifies in their request builder; b) our SDK docs and one-liner curl sample in 0.9.2 show the stringified example for some languages; c) server doesn't classify/validate stringified inputs with helpful errors.

priya: Remediation plan: 
- short term: ask customer to send array (show them exact curl) and apply one-time credits.
- server: add input-shape validation to detect "input is a JSON string that parses to array" and return 400 with message: "input must be an array of strings; do not send a JSON-encoded string. See example."
- SDK: patch 0.9.3 to fix examples and add guardrail that warns when input is string.

morgan: Created PR #478 to add server-side validation and better error text. Added unit test cases for stringified array, ndjson, and gzip flows.

sre-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: 2025-04-02T03:00:00Z. If canary looks good will promote.

erin (cs): Customer notified of workaround and timeline, offered credits. They accepted. Keeping ticket open until canary is promoted.

alex h: Also adding telemetry alert to catch sudden spikes in model variant (text-embed-512) usage per API key — will help detect similar mis-encodings earlier.

priya: Quick diagnostic snippet we suggested to customer (node): 
```js
// guard: detect stringified array inputs before call
if (typeof body.input === 'string') {
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(body.input);
    if (Array.isArray(parsed)) console.warn('input appears to be a JSON-stringified array; send as real array');
  } catch (e) { /* not JSON */ }
}
```

erin (cs): Follow-ups: send patch notes to customer, mention telemetry alert, close when deploy is fully rolled out. Thanks team :heart:

morgan: tagging for postmortem notes and knowledge base entry.

priya: will draft KB: 'Embeddings shape mismatch — common client-side encoding mistakes' and include examples for double-stringify, ndjson vs array, and gzip content-type gotchas.

erin (cs): Great — moving to "pending deploy".
